instruction: I want to enable minimal view mode in VLC to have a cleaner interface with fewer controls visible. How can I configure VLC to start in minimal view by default?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC. The evaluator checks the VLC config file for qt-minimal-view setting, expecting it to be set to 1 (enabled). This uses the existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from the appropriate OS-specific location
Metric function correctly parses the config file and searches for 'qt-minimal-view=' setting
Metric properly defaults to '0' (disabled) if setting not found, matching VLC's default behavior
Expected value (1) correctly represents enabling minimal view mode in VLC
Metric correctly handles parameter passing - directly accesses rule['expected_qt_minimal_view'] without incorrect nested access
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to verify the setting persists across sessions, which is necessary to verify 'start in minimal view by default'
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement to enable minimal view mode and configure VLC to start with it by default
Edge cases handled: file not found and general exceptions are caught and logged
